title: Mon Paris des Toujours by Marin Montagut
body: A Guide to the Timeless Soul of the City” by Marin Montagut, a beautiful home store I discovered on my last trip to Paris, is my first French book. It showcases the brand’s favourite Parisian spots through elegant illustrations and typography, reflecting the store’s signature style and identity.
alt: Forever Paris from Marin Montagut in French

title: A Thousand Feasts by Nigel Slater
